name: mirofish
description: SimSend (MiroFish) - marketing campaign audience simulation engine

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && uv run python wsgi.py
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest && cd ../frontend && npm test
